create_weights_loader: create a custom WeightsLoader subclass to load quantized tensors from Safetensors files with tensor parallelism support
load_unquantized_weights: load unquantized Torch tensors from Safetensors files using DefaultWeightsLoader with UnquantizedWeight class
shard_packed_weights: shard packed QKV or gate-up projection weights across tensor parallel ranks using get_packed_sharded
get_sharded_tensor: get a sharded portion of a tensor along a specified dimension for distributed inference across GPU ranks
convert_blocks_to_sizes: convert block counts or proportional ratios into concrete block sizes for splitting packed weight tensors
